title: 云依助手 0.13.12
releaseNotes: Improved packet inspector layout for default and scaled desktop windows, keeping protocol navigation and current selection beside byte and field views. Payload-field actions now belong to their corresponding protocol nodes and reveal the focused editor. Byte rows automatically adapt to available width while retaining manual 8/16/32-column choices. Preserves the initial packet start, selected bytes during resizing and ordinary manual scrolling. Clarifies raw-byte integers versus parsed protocol fields; validated sixteen responsive configurations and existing parser/storage regressions.
